metadata.title: Email Data Protection
metadata.description: Defines trust properties required to prevent email from becoming an uncontrolled channel for sensitive data. This pattern addresses misdelivery, over-sharing, attachment misuse, and policy enforcement, without addressing records retention or malicious content.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for preventing inappropriate disclosure, loss, or misuse of sensitive information transmitted via email.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Email content handling, attachment processing, data loss prevention mechanisms, and policy-based message controls.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing how sensitive data is handled and constrained when transmitted through email.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Email data protection assumes baseline delivery assurance, identity binding, and accountability are already established.

props.name: data-object
props.remarks: Email message content and attachments as managed institutional information objects subject to data protection policy.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for trustworthy email guidance related to policy enforcement, monitoring, and prevention of inappropriate data disclosure.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for guidance on preventing over-sharing, attachment misuse, and uncontrolled data exposure via email.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced to emphasize email as a potential data exfiltration vector whose misuse can cause cascading organizational impact.

metadata.remarks: Email Data Protection constrains the handling of sensitive data in email communications through identification, policy enforcement, and misuse prevention without addressing malware detection or records retention.

components.title: Sensitive Content Identification
components.description: Identifies sensitive or restricted information in email bodies and attachments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or exposure of sensitive data through email content.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Classification and identification of sensitive data prior to transmission.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Email content and attachments are assessed to identify sensitive information prior to transmission.
Adaptive or risk-based mechanisms constrain transmission of sensitive information.

components.title: Email Data Transmission Controls
components.description: Constrains how sensitive information may be transmitted via email.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of data over application-layer protocols such as email.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement restricting how sensitive information may traverse email channels.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define allowable use of email for transmitting sensitive information.
Email data transmission privileges follow the principle of least privilege.

components.title: Misdelivery and Misuse Prevention
components.description: Reduces risk of unintended recipients or inappropriate sharing of email content.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exposure of email content due to incorrect recipients or unauthorized mailbox access.

props.name: defensive-technique
props.remarks: Restrictions and safeguards to prevent inappropriate disclosure of email content.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls mitigate inadvertent release of sensitive email information.
Mechanisms detect anomalous or inappropriate data handling in email.
